background: var. hennebergi no. 10; ORSTOM fungal collection

sources.context: Aspergillus niger var. hennebergi no. 10 on agar surfaces; direct germ-tube, hyphal-diameter, distal-hypha and colony-radial measurements support a coarse filamentous/hyphal presentation.

provenance.context: Coarse representative morphology for the exact ORSTOM no. 10 agar-surface evidence pack selected for Petra's first fungal source-validation mode.
provenance.transferNote: The source evidence is used only to authorize the coarse filamentous-hyphal presentation class for this exact named pack. Renderer detail is not promoted into biological state.
provenance.limitation: Authorizes only a representative filamentous/hyphal presentation. It does not authorize physical hyphal diameter in renderer units, branch probability or angle, anastomosis, literal segment identity or count, biomass-to-hyphal-length conversion, orientation dynamics, resource uptake, growth kinetics, or any bacteria-fungus interaction.
